notes.note: Reviewed new complete pinned-table validation paragraph against shared parseKeyTable, POSIX whole-table guard and bundled Windows core. Unsupported/retired grants, malformed entries and duplicate IDs refuse before acceptance; explicit fixture-key exceptions remain separately described. New Preview-grant case failed before POSIX fix and passed across four entrypoints afterward;118 total focused tests passed. Existing format/consumer, schema1 fixture compatibility, Node/runtime, freshness, publisher custody and installation limits are unchanged. No actual Windows installation or production release qualification claimed.

Reviewed the complete POSIX public-manifest key-table validation delta against shared parseKeyTable, Windows installer-core composition, the real shell caller and the18 directly citing documents. The POSIX path now validates every entry (shape, unique key ID, Ed25519 key type and supported ring grants) before selecting a key. The new Preview-grant corpus case failed on the original POSIX code while signer/shared already refused; after repair all118 focused cases passed through real entrypoints, including the extracted Windows core under Node. Normal Stable/Nightly grants, signature bytes, URL/digest/provenance checks, home/port/service/install/rollback paths and publication authority are unchanged. Manifest README documents complete-table refusal. Other cited getting-started, platform/store, release, lifecycle and CLI claims remain accurate for valid tables; ADR0020 stays historical. Generated installer check, lint and scripts types passed. No live provider, native/device, PowerShell installation or release qualification renewed.

Reviewed full corpus, signer/shared/POSIX/Windows-core callers, key fixture and descriptor producer/consumer. Common signing grants now admit Stable/Nightly; assembly uses Nightly schema2/ref identity and the Nightly key, preserving legacy exact-tag/source/ring controls. All artifact-format/order/URL/digest/signature and cross-key/channel refusals remain. A per-vector key-table input adds the independent retired Preview-grant refusal across all four entrypoints without a production seam. Initial hosted70 failures were masked by stale authority fixtures; local repaired baseline117pass/1newPOSIXfailure demonstrated the real parity gap, followed by118/118 after the POSIX repair. Fixed canonical payload/signature source bytes equal86e8200 exactly. Cited release/development/packaging guides remain accurate; no platform installation/publication proof claimed.
